# Billing Account Name

The billing account name is a display name assigned to a [*billing account*](#glossary:billing-account). Billing account name is commonly used for invoice reconciliation.

Billing account Name values are set by the provider.

A billing Account Name can be renamed.

```sql
SELECT 'Billing account Name' FROM focus_data_table
```

## Requirements

BillingAccountName MUST adhere to the following requirements:

* BillingAccountName MUST be of type String.

## Column ID

BillingAccountName

## Display Name

Billing Account Name
